name: @ai-gateway/vercel-adapter
description: Vercel-native composition root (EM-5.5, revised). Since the architecture revision, the platform-package wiring (bootstrap()/GatewayApp) and the HTTP layer (router/handlers/parsing/validation/response-shaping) live in @ai-gateway/gateway-runtime, shared with apps/gateway-server; this app owns only its own env-var loading and its own Vercel Function entrypoint/warm-instance lifecycle. Additive: apps/gateway-server is unmodified and remains the reference Node/container deployment.
